title: Math for Data Science: the first 10 videos
subtitle: Ten videos, two hours, first year
description: The ten videos to watch before anything else in a data science degree: linear algebra as geometry rather than grids of numbers, one honest look at what calculus is actually about, and the statistics you will spend the next three years being asked to interpret. Visual and conceptual throughout.

title: The Balance System: health, work and a life that fits together
subtitle: Twelve pillars, 35 videos, one follow-along system
channel: TED, Huberman Lab, Kurzgesagt and 28 more
description: Fix energy first, then attention, then the calendar - a step-by-step system for health, work and a life that fits together.

title: Gemini Enterprise, zero to hero
subtitle: Google's agentic platform, end to end
channel: Google Cloud, Google for Developers and 11 others
description: Forty-nine videos in a teaching order: what Gemini Enterprise is, how it relates to Vertex AI and the Agentspace it replaced, turning it on, grounding it in company data, then agents — no-code first, then ADK, MCP and A2A, multi-agent systems, governance, and what it takes to run one in production.

title: أسماء الله الحسنى
subtitle: The Beautiful Names of Allah
description: Forty-seven short talks, one divine name at a time — what each name means, where it appears in the Qur'an, and what it asks of the listener. Watch progress, ratings, tags and per-video notes are kept in your browser.

title: دورة رد الشبهات
subtitle: Responding to Doubts
description: A 33-lesson course on recognising and answering doubts raised about Islam, wrapped in a tracker that keeps watch progress, ratings, tags, notes and per-video annotations in the browser.
